name: Victory Road 1F Boulder Trials
summary: Enter the foreboding caverns of Victory Road from Route 23. Deploy the Dolly to roll heavy granite boulders onto white pressure plates, unlocking ancient stone gates to advance deeper into the cave complex.

items.name: TM52 Focus Blast
items.method: Found on the elevated northeastern plateau past the first boulder gate

items.name: Rare Candy
items.method: Lying on the cavern floor in the far northeast alcove

items.name: Full Restore
items.method: Hidden in the isolated rock outcropping near the northeast corner

items.name: Ultra Ball
items.method: Hidden inside a fractured rock near the central corridor
